# Components

Import every component from `uiofcraft`, or from `uiofcraft/<name>` for one file. Read [../usage.md](../usage.md) first.

| Component | What it is |
|---|---|
| [Accordion](./accordion.md) | A set of collapsible panels with headings and content. |
| [Alert](./alert.md) | A callout for displaying important information. |
| [Alert Dialog](./alert-dialog.md) | A dialog that requires user response to proceed. |
| [Autocomplete](./autocomplete.md) | An input that suggests options as you type. |
| [Avatar](./avatar.md) | An image element with a fallback for representing the user. |
| [Badge](./badge.md) | A badge or a component that looks like a badge. |
| [Breadcrumb](./breadcrumb.md) | Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links. |
| [Button](./button.md) | A button or a component that looks like a button. |
| [Calendar](./calendar.md) | A date picker component with range and multi-select support. |
| [Card](./card.md) | A content container for grouping related information. |
| [Checkbox](./checkbox.md) | A control allowing the user to toggle between checked and not checked. |
| [Checkbox Group](./checkbox-group.md) | Provides shared state to a series of checkboxes. |
| [Collapsible](./collapsible.md) | A collapsible panel controlled by a button trigger. |
| [Combobox](./combobox.md) | An input combined with a list of predefined items to select. |
| [Command](./command.md) | A command palette component built with Dialog and Autocomplete for searching and executing commands. |
| [Composer](./composer.md) | A composer for chat and AI assistant interfaces, with a growing input, persistent actions, and optional mentions or slash commands. |
| [Context Menu](./context-menu.md) | A menu that appears at the pointer on right click or long press. |
| [Dialog](./dialog.md) | A popup that opens on top of the entire page. |
| [Drawer](./drawer.md) | A panel that slides in from the edge of the screen with swipe gestures, snap points, and nested drawer support. |
| [Empty](./empty.md) | A container for displaying empty state information. |
| [Field](./field.md) | A component that provides labelling and validation for form controls. |
| [Fieldset](./fieldset.md) | A native fieldset element with a legend. |
| [Form](./form.md) | A form wrapper component that simplifies validation and submission. |
| [Frame](./frame.md) | A framed container for grouping related information. |
| [Group](./group.md) | A component for visually grouping a series of controls. |
| [Input](./input.md) | A native input element. |
| [Input Group](./input-group.md) | A flexible component for grouping inputs with addons, buttons, and other elements. |
| [Kbd](./kbd.md) | A component for displaying keyboard keys and shortcuts. |
| [Label](./label.md) | Renders an accessible label associated with controls. |
| [Menu](./menu.md) | A list of actions in a dropdown, enhanced with keyboard navigation. |
| [Meter](./meter.md) | A graphical display of a numeric value within a range. |
| [Number Field](./number-field.md) | A numeric input element with increment and decrement buttons, and a scrub area. |
| [OTP Field](./otp-field.md) | A segmented input for one-time passwords and verification codes. |
| [Pagination](./pagination.md) | A pagination with page navigation, next and previous links. |
| [Popover](./popover.md) | An accessible popup anchored to a button. |
| [Preview Card](./preview-card.md) | A popup that appears when a link is hovered, showing a preview for sighted users. |
| [Progress](./progress.md) | Displays the status of a task that takes a long time. |
| [Radio Group](./radio-group.md) | A set of checkable buttons where no more than one of the buttons can be checked at a time. |
| [Scroll Area](./scroll-area.md) | A native scroll container with custom scrollbars. |
| [Segmented Control](./segmented-control.md) | A visual pattern for presenting related choices, navigation destinations, filters, or content views. |
| [Select](./select.md) | A common form component for choosing a predefined value in a dropdown menu. |
| [Separator](./separator.md) | A separator element accessible to screen readers. |
| [Sheet](./sheet.md) | A flyout that opens from the side of the screen, based on the dialog component. |
| [Sidebar](./sidebar.md) | An app sidebar with a header, groups, menus, a footer and a trigger that collapses it. |
| [Skeleton](./skeleton.md) | A loading state skeleton for your components. |
| [Slider](./slider.md) | An input where the user selects a value from within a given range. |
| [Spinner](./spinner.md) | An indicator that can be used to show a loading state. |
| [Switch](./switch.md) | A control that indicates whether a setting is on or off. |
| [Table](./table.md) | A simple table component for displaying tabular data. |
| [Tabs](./tabs.md) | A component for toggling between related panels on the same page. |
| [Textarea](./textarea.md) | A native textarea element. |
| [Toast](./toast.md) | A temporary notification that appears on screen to inform users. |
| [Toggle](./toggle.md) | A two-state button that can be toggled on or off. |
| [Toggle Group](./toggle-group.md) | Provides a shared state to a series of toggle buttons. |
| [Toolbar](./toolbar.md) | A container for grouping a set of buttons and controls. |
| [Tooltip](./tooltip.md) | A popup that appears when an element is hovered or focused, showing a hint for sighted users. |

## Patterns

Built from the components above, not exported on their own.

| Pattern | What it is |
|---|---|
| [Date Picker](./date-picker.md) | A date picker component built with Calendar and Popover. |
